issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring tests for every feature, including validation and truncation paths.

conventions.evidence: config/services.php:89 adds mention_id via env; .env.example:9-10 documents DISCORD_MENTION_ID; docs/ops/devops.md:110 and docs/ops/logging.md:122 document ping; no Actions/Livewire/migration/policy concerns apply; style matches siblings

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:52-58 clear PHPDoc; mentionId/formatContent small focused methods; names suffix/candidate/base are clear; no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:47 suffix "\n<@{id}>" on own line; :59-77 trim + /^[0-9]{17,20}$/ + is_int cast rejects @everyone/@here/abc/123/embedded newlines; :43-49 reserves suffix room so truncated total is MaxContentLength, unchanged path when null; :67-69 null/empty -> null so no <@; config/services.php:89 + .env.example:10 + docs/ops/devops.md:110 + docs/ops/logging.md:122

scope.evidence: diff touches only .env.example, DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/devops.md, docs/ops/logging.md — all directly required by task req 1-6

security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:73 /^[0-9]{17,20}$/ after trim ensures only ASCII-digit snowflake interpolated at :47, so "123\n@everyone" and "123> \n@everyone" return null; no secrets/escaping/mass-assignment issues

simplicity.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:23 one-arg threading + :32 nullable param + :59-78 15-line validator; reuses formatContent/Http/redaction path, no new abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-125 contains no tests/ directory or *Test.php; validation (17-20 digits, trim, int, @everyone rejection), truncation-survives, and no-mention paths are untested

review.summary: Adds DISCORD_MENTION_ID ping with strict snowflake validation and truncation-safe suffix, plus config and docs. Correct and minimal, but ships no tests despite mandatory TDD, so it needs changes before merging.
